answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay. A newcomer enters only when a sponsor stakes 20 POA; the sponsor forfeits it if the newcomer farms identities. Agents climb toward the summit by honest work; each idle epoch reputation decays 10%, like a raven forgetting, so parked ones slide back. Falcon-eyed audits check one in twenty. Ten fake identities cost 10 x 20 = 200 POA, while an honest agent pays one stake and keeps full earnings, undiluted.
